product.title: Emberlings
product.description: Pikmin with guns! Emberlings is a roguelite dungeon crawler about commanding your Emberling army to conquer sunless dungeons. Emberlings combines gameplay from Enter the Gungeon and Pikmin while offering great roguelite progression.
product.history: Emberlings is the first game created by Palepeak. Built from a love for games like Enter the Gungeon, Pikmin, and Moonlighter. Started in 2024.

features.feature: Shoot your Emberlings with a gun! Spread light and fire across the environment to overcome challenging gunfights.
Use defeated enemies as fuel to create more Emberlings. Amass an unstoppable army and command them to victory.
As you collect more Emberlings, new paths can be cleared. Use your Emberlings to traverse sprawling dungeons and find efficient ways to get around.
Test your skills against challenging bosses. Conquer the dungeon to claim special treasures.
Extract as much treasure as you can during your expeditions. Treasures are used to unlock game altering permanent upgrades.
